title: FlowWeb learns which message worked: each signup traces back to the draft that brought it

source.ref: Daniel (2026-11-10): FlowWeb flows should have all tracking hooked up and keep analyzing the data and shifting the campaigns.

detail: FlowWeb links carried region and hunt (utm_campaign) but no draft id, and Frequency kept no utm_content, so no signup could be tied to the message, hunt or wording that brought it; region numbers reached FlowWeb only as a staff CSV download. Fix: /start pages store utm_content (the FlowWeb draft id) with the lead and member funnel record; POST /api/webhooks/flowweb-outcomes, signed with FLOWWEB_OUTCOMES_SECRET (same HMAC scheme as flowweb-claim), answers counts per utm_campaign + utm_content (leads, members, hosts, paid) plus the region numbers. Counts only, no name or email leaves; a failed read answers 500, never zeros. The region read moved to lib/onboarding/region-metrics-load.ts, shared with /admin/growth/flowweb-metrics. Owner step: set FLOWWEB_OUTCOMES_SECRET in Production and the same value on the Mac (docs/RUNBOOKS.md "FlowWeb outcomes pull").
